arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import parse

# Test various patterns with trailing newline
tests = [
    ('{}', 'hello\n'),
    ('{:d}', '42\n'),
    ('{:f}', '3.14\n'),
    ('hello {}!', 'hello world!\n'),
]

for fmt, val in tests:
    p = parse.Parser(fmt)
    print(f'Pattern: {p._match_re.pattern!r}')
    m = p._match_re.match(val)
    print(f'Match({repr(val)}): {m}')
    if m:
        print(f'  span: {m.span()}')
    print()
"
